macros.name: textfrac
macros.doc: \textfrac renders its two arguments as a fraction, using \textsu for the numerator and \textin for the denominator.

macros.name: textin
macros.doc: \textin renders its argument in inferior figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textlf
macros.doc: \textlf and \texttlf render their arguments in tabular lining figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textosf
macros.doc: \textosf and \texttosf render their arguments in tabular oldstyle figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: textsu
macros.doc: \textsu renders its argument in superior figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: texttlf
macros.doc: \textlf and \texttlf render their arguments in tabular lining figures, no matter what the default figure style.

macros.name: texttosf
macros.doc: \textosf and \texttosf render their arguments in tabular oldstyle figures, no matter what the default figure style.
